models.name: Meshy 7.1 - Text-to-3D
models.shortDescription: This is Meshy's current text-to-3D generator. Its higher geometry resolution tiers add finer surface detail, which suits carved wood grain, planks and metal banding, and it returns PBR maps for a realistic wood-and-iron look.

models.name: Rodin Gen-2.5 Text to 3D
models.shortDescription: Rodin Gen-2.5 builds production-oriented meshes from text, with selectable quality tiers and PBR materials. The HighPack add-on upgrades textures to 4K, which helps on a detailed hero prop.

models.name: Tripo P2 Text to 3D
models.shortDescription: Tripo P2 is a native 3D diffusion model that aims for clean topology. It responds well to concise subject-plus-material prompts like a wooden chest, and it offers PBR texturing and optional quad output.
